lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: Nobody knows I'm here. Dockson thinks I'm asleep. Sazed will guess by morning.

lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: Kelsier said the eleventh metal would show me what the Lord Ruler really is. Fine. I'll get close enough to burn it and find out.

lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: Court first. Then the Hall of Spires. Stay above the patrols, stay out of the red light, and keep copper burning near anything that looks like it's listening.
